rust_summary: entity handles on a client (`native_entity` and the `entity_*` and `living_*` reads over the entities the server shows the window, armor stands' custom names and equipment included) and the stacks of a server-opened menu by slot (`native_menu_stacks`).
doc_summary: on a client, `host.entity(id)` and the `entity_*` and `living_*` reads work against the entities the server shows the window (what a client knows: position, rotation, type, UUID, custom name, equipment; no saved data or tags; writes refused), and `host.menu_stacks()` gives the open server-opened menu's stacks, with their components, by slot. Bundles need "hooks": @API:client_entity_refs@.
